allow: PowerShell($body = "grant_type=password&username=admin@sorcha.local&password=$\([uri]::EscapeDataString\('Dev_Pass_2025!'\)\)&client_id=sorcha-cli"; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost/api/service-auth/token -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $body; Write-Host "token_len=$\($r.access_token.Length\)"; $h=@{Authorization="Bearer $\($r.access_token\)"}; $peers = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost/api/peers -Headers $h; Write-Host "peers=$\($peers.Count\)"; $peers | ForEach-Object { Write-Host "  $\($_.nodeId\)  status=$\($_.connectionStatus\)  adverts=$\($_.advertisedRegisters.Count\)" }; $c = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost/api/peers/connected -Headers $h; Write-Host "connected=$\($c.connectedPeerCount\)"; $env:SORCHA_LOCAL_TOKEN = $r.access_token)

PowerShell($body = "grant_type=password&username=admin@sorcha.local&password=$\([uri]::EscapeDataString\('Dev_Pass_2025!'\)\)&client_id=sorcha-cli"; $tok = \(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost/api/service-auth/token -Method Post -ContentType 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' -Body $body\).access_token; $h=@{Authorization="Bearer $tok"; 'Content-Type'='application/json'}; $me = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost/api/auth/me -Headers $h; Write-Host "org_id=$\($me.organizationId\) user_id=$\($me.userId\)"; $env:LOCAL_TOK=$tok; $env:LOCAL_ORG=$me.organizationId; $env:LOCAL_USER=$me.userId)
